descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S24 iOS simulator build on the local stack: patient delete and one item delete, confirmation and message inside the app

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Deleting a patient hard-deletes all of that patient's data immediately (removed, not hidden), and the audit log is kept. (UAT TC-24; TFA-92579 AC 2; TFA-94699 AC 4)
  • U7 Deleting a patient asks for confirmation exactly once: tapping the card's trash icon opens a pop-up designed like the app UI that says what deleting does, with Cancel and OK; Cancel keeps everything. (UAT TC-24; TFA-92579 AC 2; TFA-92579 AC 7; TFA-94699 AC 6)
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident. (UAT 3.3; UAT TC-24)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given An iOS simulator / debug build of main bundled for the local stack, signed in with a @roundai.test account, synthetic patients

When Delete a Hospital patient from its card (Cancel, then OK) and, in Nursing Home, the resident if a control exists (Q7); delete one task to see whether any confirmation shows inside the app

Then Same outcomes as S03 and S05. Inside the app's web view the patient confirmation looks like the app, not a system alert (TFA-92579 AC 7), and the deleted message shows (AC 8). The task delete's confirmation is recorded for U8 (S19), not judged here.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): S03 / S05 checkpoints, judged by a person from simulator screenshots. A window.confirm inside the web view shows as a native alert, which fails AC 7 (Q10).

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S24 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-24.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: DEVICE · Real device (iOS / Android) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: TC-24 Deletions · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-24/S24

iOS simulator build on the local stack: patient delete and one item delete, confirmation and message inside the app

Tickets: TFA-92579 Home Screen: Patient Chart Card (ready for qa); TFA-94699 Data Retention & Purge (in progress)

New local lane newspec-c: status blocked in newspec-c/results.json → blocked (blocked).

Detail:

iOS simulator (new device, created and deleted by the test; the debug build of e02167f for the local stack, built outside the checkout): the app installs, opens on its sign-in screen, and with the account's session placed in the WebView's storage opens on the Hospital list, then on the Nursing Home list after the account's context changed (screenshots). The delete flow itself was not run on iOS: nothing on the simulator can be tapped without a permission prompt here. Android stand-in (TC-01/S24 run): the patient delete confirm is Android's system dialog (CANCEL / OK), no 'deleted' message shows, Nursing Home residents have no delete control, and a task delete has no confirmation - known B24 (AC 7 / AC 8). Our addition (10-15 review).

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: set-aside — set-aside: iOS/Android (Quinn 2026-10-14) — iOS simulator build: iOS and Android are set aside for the dev run (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
